maintenance_led.reason: Sells new UGG and HOKA footwear and apparel to consumers and retailers; first-time purchases, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers and retailers buying UGG, HOKA and Teva footwear, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building its own brands, HOKA and UGG, through wholesale and direct-to-consumer sales, not acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer footwear brands; retailers and consumers can easily switch to other footwear brands without disruption.
